name: 07740 · Long Branch, NJ
findings: ZIP 07740 (Long Branch) has 135 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07740 (Long Branch) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07740 (Long Branch) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
